resources.string: Download 32 MiB from this paired PC to measure HTTP throughput. This uses network data and may affect other streams. No streaming settings will change.
Measuring HTTP throughput… The transfer stops after 30 seconds. Leave this screen or tap Cancel to stop.

This includes request overhead and is not a guarantee of UDP streaming quality. Leave headroom for audio and recovery data. PyroWave quality targets at 60 FPS are about 277 Mbps at 720p, 399 Mbps at 1080p and 1593 Mbps at 4K. If the network is slower, use HEVC or AV1.
